actions.text: Hi, thanks for your interest in QPay. We help businesses run counter POS, mobile POS, self-order kiosk, QR ordering, and more. How can I help you today?
actions.fallback_text: Please tap one of the options so I can help you faster.

actions.text: QPay is an all-in-one commerce system for businesses that want POS, kiosk, QR ordering, webstore, inventory, loyalty, and reporting in one ecosystem.
Which part would you like to know more about?
Our counter POS setup is great for cashier flow, inventory control, payment tracking, receipts, and daily sales reporting. It suits stores and front-counter operations that need fast checkout.
Our kiosk setup helps customers order by themselves, reduces queue congestion, and improves upsell opportunities. It works well for high-traffic F&B and self-service environments.
Our all-in-one setup combines counter POS, mobile ordering, kiosk, QR ordering, loyalty, and reporting into one connected system so your business can scale without switching platforms.
Would you like to get pricing, book a showroom demo, or talk to sales?
Tell us what kind of business you run so we can recommend the right setup.
actions.footer: We will match the setup to your business flow.
